title: Best robot vacuum deal: Get the Dreame L40 Ultra Gen 2 for $250 off
excerpt: Let a high-power robot handle the floors while you keep $250 in your pocket.
content_html:
SAVE $250: As of Sept. 25, the Dreame L40 Ultra Gen 2 Robot Vacuum and Mop is down to $499.99 at Amazon. That's a 33% discount on a high-suction, fully automated flagship robot cleaner.

Credit: Dreame

$499.99 at Amazon
$749.99 Save $250

If you're looking for a top-tier robot vacuum that cleans your floors entirely on autopilot, Amazon just chopped $250 off one of the best on the market. As of Sept. 25, you can score the Dreame L40 Ultra Gen 2 Robot Vacuum and Mop for $499.99, down from its usual $749.99 list price.

The Gen 2 packs a massive 25,000Pa engine with five customizable suction levels, so it pulls pet hair, stray cat litter, and ground-in dirt out of high-pile carpets instead of just skimming the surface. The Dreame L40 uses robotic arms to physically extend its side brush and mop pads. It reaches deep into 90-degree baseboard corners and underneath low couch legs to snag dust bunnies where other vacuums fail.

You also don't have to worry about soggy rugs. When it hits a carpeted room, it automatically lifts its dual spinning mop pads up by 0.41 inches (10.5mm) and cranks up the vacuum power. Once the run is finished, it returns to the dock to empty its own dustbin, wash its mop pads, and dry them with warm air so they don't sit around smelling like a damp towel.

Using 3D structured light and LiDAR mapping, the robot maps out your floor plan in minutes. It actively identifies everyday floor clutter and navigates around it without getting hung up. The massive 5,200mAh battery runs for up to 231 minutes on a single charge, and you can set it to charge during off-peak hours to keep your electricity bill down.
